audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers read Ryze, Skill, Singed, Singed, Ryze, Singed, Singed — the exact inverse of the already-audited Singed side (Singed, Singed, Skill, Skill, Ryze, Ryze, Skill) and of the page's own whys[], which give Singed levels 1-2 and Ryze the Seraph's timing.
audit.why: Levels 1-2 Ryze has no root and must step into Poison Trail to farm; the first mana item is where his loop outruns pre-Rylai's Singed; two items is level again once Rylai's and Insanity Potion land. 48.53% over 272 games fits a lane Ryze does not own.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1 -> Singed; rows 2, 3 -> Skill; row 5 -> Ryze; row 6 -> Skill, as matched full/content pairs, with ratings and the two why lines that would have contradicted their new side.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[3].why and phases[6].why were generic Ryze-favoured filler that fought their corrected sides.
audit.why: Levels 4-5 are a mutual grind around his proxy, and at two items Rylai's plus Insanity Potion (100s flat, and it makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds) make him a side-lane problem Ryze solves with Realm Warp instead of duels.

audit.whatIsWrong: Fling was described only as 'the flip into his goo' — the page never stated Riot's actual clause: 'If the target Singed flings lands in his Mega Adhesive, they are also rooted.' Its range (125) and cooldown (10/9.5/9/8.5/8) were also absent.
audit.why: Mega Adhesive first, then Fling into it, is a hard root on a champion with no dash — that chain, not the poison, is what kills Ryze. Knowing Fling is a 125-range melee ability tells you exactly how far back the safe line is.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d, report[5].t and whys[1] rewritten with the range, the cooldown and the Adhesive root.

edits.before: Phase Rush turns his engage into your trade window — combo, proc the speed, and walk away untouched.
edits.after: Both grind: he proxies for gold, you farm safely — chasing into Poison Trail is how the even lane tilts.

edits.before: Seraph's online — you out-DPS and out-tank everyone in extended fights. Side-lane and Warp to every fight.
edits.after: Rylai's and Insanity Potion make him unkillable in the side lane — win with Warp fights, not duels.

edits.before: The flip into his goo — never chase into range while it is up. Commit on its cooldown, never into it.
edits.after: Fling is 125 range and 10s at rank 1 — landing in Mega Adhesive roots you, so break the goo line first.

edits.before: Track Singed’s Fling: The flip into his goo — never chase into range while it is up. It’s down or you don’t go.
edits.after: Track Singed’s Fling: 10s at rank 1, 125 range, and it roots you if it drops you inside Mega Adhesive.

edits.before: His Fling cooldown is the only window to safely root him; without it, any W commit sends you into the poison and nets negative HP.
edits.after: Fling runs 10s at rank 1 and roots you outright if it drops you in Mega Adhesive — only W once you have seen it spent.

notes: Carried over from the Singed-side audit: spikes[2] and wants.you[0] on that page call Ryze 'short-ranged'; Overload is 1000 range, and the same framing leaks into this page's early ('must walk to melee range to farm') — Ryze farms at Q range, not melee. It does not rewrite inside the band without losing the paragraph's point, so it is flagged, not edited. packet suspectNames hit on wants.foe[0] 'Run Poison Trail' is a FALSE POSITIVE. Also worth a later pass: Insanity Potion makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds, which is why report[8].t's early anti-heal note is only half the story — his R answers YOUR sustain, not the reverse.
